John and Zack head to California's Sonoma County to help volunteer firefighter Scott and his wife, Xanthie, build a home to replace the one they lost in the Northern California wildfires of 2017.
Kyle and Whitney have realized they really don't need a lot of stuff to enjoy life and want to build a home to reflect just that.

John and Zack are confident that they can build a tiny house with country charm for two empty nesters, until they learn that the couple want room for their kids and grandkids to visit when they're on the road.
The Grahams are looking for a craftsman-style tiny house which needs to both hold up against the brutal winters they will soon face, and pack enough functionality for the whole family.

Chris and Tamara absolutely love skiing and snowboarding and have asked John and Zack to help build them a modern ski lodge that has functional space to not only store all their gear, but also maintain it.
A young bachelor from Massachusetts builds a 150 sq. foot mobile Tiny House with New England charm on the outside and modern technology on the inside.

Michelle and Blake love having their friends over for drinks and some card playing; they've asked John and Zack to help build them a tiny house that not only has space to entertain their friends, but room to keep their two dogs entertained as well.
